stories.title: Trump endorses embattled Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for reelection
stories.description: Trump said in a post on social media that Netanyahu "has been a Great Warrior Prime Minister, and an even greater Partner for Peace in combatting the Islamic Republic of Iran."

stories.title: Houthi missile attack on Yemeni presidential palace kills five, minister says
stories.description: Yemen's information minister says the prime minister and other ministers were unhurt when ballistic missiles hit al-Maashiq Palace.

stories.title: Container ship hit by projectile sinks in Strait of Hormuz, Singapore says
stories.description: All 21 sailors on the Singapore-flagged GFS Pride were evacuated safely after it was hit by an projectile on Tuesday, maritime authorities say.

stories.title: Houthi missile hits Aramco building after Saudi-led coalition strike on Yemen fuel depot
stories.description: The Saudi energy ministry says the Houthi attack caused a "limited fire" at Aramco's headquarters complex in Dhahran.

stories.title: Saudi minister vows 'serious response' to Houthi attacks on airports
stories.description: It comes after the armed group hit Riyadh's international airport and another facility, killing 13 people, in a significant escalation.

stories.title: Who are the Houthis and what do they want?
stories.description: Their fighting with pro-government forces over Yemen's Red Sea coast and attacks on Saudi Arabia has put the spotlight on the Iran-backed group.

stories.title: BBC's Orla Guerin travels with Yemen's southern national security forces through desert battlefield
stories.description: Orla Guerin travelled through Yemen, with forces loyal to its internationally recognised government, to a remote desert battlefield where Houthi rebels were dislodged just days ago.

stories.title: Why is it so hard to fight the Houthis?
stories.description: Security correspondent Frank Gardner explains how the Iran-backed Houthis' precision strikes and guerrilla tactics have made it difficult for Saudi forces to gain the upper hand.

stories.title: Zelensky holds US talks as Trump accuses him of not wanting peace
stories.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky spoke with US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner on Sunday amid tensions after US President Donald Trump accused Kyiv of resisting peace with Russia. stories.description: US President Donald Trump on Sunday endorsed Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ahead of Israel's October 27 elections. stories.title: Trump defends Russian sanctions relief, lashes out at Zelenskyy

stories.title: Iran war live: US issues Middle East security alert; Yemen fighting flares
stories.description: US embassies in the Middle East have issued a security alert for Americans as fighting in Yemen continues to ramp up.

stories.title: Fire engulfs Albania’s Supreme Court as protests enter fifth day

stories.title: Tensions over headscarves, Israel test Azerbaijan-Turkiye ties
stories.description: The normally close ties between Turkiye and Azerbaijan have come under strain, fuelled by a dispute over Baku’s restrictions on headscarves in schools and disagreements over Israel. stories.description: JERUSALEM: Israeli settlers on Saturday attacked a convoy of European diplomats and beat up a visiting French mayor, in a new escalation of violence during the Palestinian olive harvest, witnesses and diplomats said. stories.title: Houthi media says Saudi strike kills 9 in northern Yemen
stories.description: The Saudi-led coalition fighting the Houthis has launched hundreds of raids in Yemen backing the internationally recognised government since the start of the renewed fighting in the long-running civil war

stories.title: Iran's new Defence Minister Akhlaghi threatens 'enormous damage' if U.S. attacks
stories.description: The veteran defence official replaces Aziz Nasirzadeh, who was killed in a U.S.-Israeli attack on a leadership compound on February 28, alongside former Supreme leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei and senior military commanders

stories.title: France protests: Police arrest 1,800 after violent clashes and looting mar protests
stories.description: The violence in Paris, Marseille, Lyon, Bordeaux and other cities occurred on the sidelines of mass demonstrations against high inflation caused in part from the U.S.-Iran war

stories.description: Mehrdad Akhlaqi Ketabchi replaces Majid Ebn al-Reza, who took over in an interim capacity after then Defence ‌Minister Aziz Nasirzadeh was killed by U.S.-Israeli strikes in February
